name: infra_tf_custom_loop_bad
title: TF2 custom training loop with a reshuffled take/skip holdout, a softmax head under from_logits=True, and no seed
origin: hardening round 2, tester domain-infra: the defective half of the TF custom-loop twin pair
note: Two of the three planted defects are recovered. MLV709 is NOT, and the reason is structural: its walk starts at a `compile()` call, and a tf.GradientTape training loop never calls compile() - the loss object is constructed directly at line 115 and handed to the step function. So the whole TF2 custom-loop family is outside MLV709's reach, and this is the high-severity defect in it that nothing reports. See the domain-infra round-2 report, finding INFRA-R2-08.
stagesObserved: config, data, preprocess, model, objective, train and eval present; `deliver` reported absent (INFRA-R2-07), `workspace.frameworks` still claims `torch` (INFRA-R2-06), and main() is drawn as an `eval_loop` (INFRA-R2-05) - all three identical to the correct twin, because none of them is caused by the planted defects.

expected.defect: full.shuffle(8192) feeds shuffled.take(1638) / shuffled.skip(1638) with reshuffle_each_iteration left at its True default
expected.why: tf.data re-draws the shuffle buffer every epoch, so the 1638 rows in `val_ds` are a different 1638 rows each pass; within a few epochs every training row has been validated on and the reported accuracy is a training accuracy

expected.defect: the head is Dense(classes, activation="softmax") and the loss at line 115 is built with from_logits=True
expected.why: SparseCategoricalCrossentropy(from_logits=True) applies its own log-softmax, so it is fed log(softmax(softmax(x))): the gradients are wrong, the loss is numerically flat, and nothing raises

expected.defect: no tf.random.set_seed, no keras.utils.set_random_seed, no np.random.seed and np.random.default_rng() is called with no seed at line 45
expected.why: the shuffle that defines the holdout, the weight initialisation and the synthetic data are all unseeded, so two runs of this script are not comparable

forbidden.why: nothing in this workspace fits a transformer
there is no torch DataLoader here; the training pipeline is a tf.data chain that does shuffle
there is no torch DataLoader here, and the eval pipeline at line 51 carries no shuffle of its own
MLV301 is a torch rule and there is no torch model; the eval step passes training=False at line 82
MLV302 is a torch rule; torch.no_grad() does not exist in TensorFlow
SparseCategoricalAccuracy argmaxes internally, so passing it the head output is correct whatever that head emits
MLV401 is the torch CrossEntropyLoss rule; the Keras contradiction here is MLV709's, and it is labelled expected above
there is no sklearn splitter and no torch random_split in this workspace; the unseeded shuffle is MLV121's and MLV601's finding, not this rule's
there is no model.fit() in this workspace at all
there is no torch.save and no torch.load anywhere
